list_checker.bridge_meaning: the four bridge lemmas are pure computation-equivalence statements: Fin-indexed Finset sums equal list folds. They introduce no axiom, no hypothesis about the data, and no new mathematical content; the frozen rule remains the only soundness source.
list_checker.why_needed: Finset.sum over Fin is kernel-reducible in this toolchain, but Matrix.vecCons projections and ℚ/Rat arithmetic are not; list literals plus structural recursion give a form the kernel always evaluates, and the bridge keeps the frozen rule as the declared semantics.

scaling_adaptation.reason: ℚ/Rat arithmetic is not kernel-reducible in this mathlib (decide gets stuck on Rat.blt / Rat.num), so the frozen checker is evaluated on exactly scaled integer data
scaling_adaptation.alpha: alpha = lcm of box/rhs denominators (104 bits)
scaling_adaptation.beta: beta = lcm of row/rhs denominators (170 bits)
scaling_adaptation.lambda: lambda = lcm of weight denominators (= 1: the archived weights are integers)
scaling_adaptation.formula: L = alpha·lo, U = alpha·hi, A = beta·a, R = alpha·beta·b, W = lambda·w
scaling_adaptation.equivalence: C^ = lambda·beta·C, B^ = lambda·alpha·beta·B, m^ = lambda·alpha·beta·m, hence B^ < m^ iff B < m (same strict contradiction)

scope_and_non_claims: Only the two declared finite box-row systems are claimed infeasible. The matrix/Physical → model-row source-row gate is explicitly separate and remains with the D137/B branch; this receipt does not claim that any original matrix branch is empty.

The threshold semantics stay distinct: V31 small-k target 1653/400, B16/high-k γ = 4132517/1000000, and AlphaSafe α are different predicates; AlphaSafe does not imply gamma-infeasibility (Basic.not_gamma_empty_of_feasible).
The negative controls show only that the modified certificate fails the check; they do not claim feasibility of the underlying system.
The abstract CoverWave cover is not called a checker and carries no acceptance claim.
No upstream module was rebuilt or re-reviewed; no sorry, no native_decide, no project axiom was introduced.
